title: Ruth Paine's sister works for the CIA; Paine brings the Oswalds to Dallas
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of Ruth Paine's sister works for the CIA; Paine brings the Oswalds to Dallas, about 1963 at Virginia; New Orleans; Dallas, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Turns out her sister works for the CIA.

plain: Dan Sheehan, a researcher on the Kennedy assassination, says on Jesse Michels's podcast that Ruth Paine, a woman who helped Lee Harvey Oswald, the man accused of killing President Kennedy, and his wife Marina, turned out to have a sister working for the CIA, the US spy agency. He says Paine brought the Oswalds from New Orleans to Dallas in 1963, where Kennedy was shot. If true, it would put the CIA close to Oswald just before the killing.
